description: This file implements the FrameOutput class for handling screen recording frame capture, including creating input surfaces, copying frames, processing pixel data, and handling frame availability callbacks in an Android environment.

classes.name: FrameOutput
classes.description: Handles frame output for screen recording, including surface creation, frame copying, pixel processing, and callback handling.

methods.name: setValueLE
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit value into a buffer in little-endian byte order.

methods.name: createInputSurface
methods.description: Creates an EGL pbuffer surface, sets up textures and buffer queues for capturing frames.

methods.name: copyFrame
methods.description: Copies a frame from the external texture to a file, including timing, pixel format conversion, and optional headers.

methods.name: reduceRgbaToRgb
methods.description: Converts RGBA pixel data to RGB by removing the alpha channel.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new frame is available, signals the condition variable.
